Click to expand...
What have you tried for troubleshooting? Have you put console.log() calls inside the conditional branches of updateHeartMeters() to verify which branch is being executed? Because that seems to be the problem, right, that the event is getting hideHeartSprites() called on it?
What do the console logs in updateHeartSprites() say? (again, provide us with information on the problem)
A few side notes, unrelated to your issue:
Personally, instead of iterating through every event on the map every frame (which could potentially be a large list) just to see if the player is in/out of range, I would simply check all map coordinates within a radius of the player, then update based on any events on those tiles. Depending on the map, it could be significantly more efficient.
Have you considered, instead of so many global functions, making all of this methods of the Scene_Map?
